output.answer:
Tencent's Q2 2024 revenue was **204.8 billion yuan** (~$28.8 billion), up **11% year-over-year**. The result was broadly in line with analyst estimates of 202.2 billion yuan.

**Key Q2 2024 figures:**
- **Revenue:** 204.8 billion yuan (+11% YoY)
- **Net profit:** 56 billion yuan (+0.7% YoY), below analyst expectations of 61.8 billion yuan
- **Value-added services ( gaming):** 98.4 billion yuan (+8% YoY)
- **Capital expenditure:** 52.8 billion yuan (more than double the prior quarter, driven by AI investment)

Source: [Reuters/Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/chinas-tencent-posts-11-second-084135153.html)
